cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Credit for the Impossible
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll welcome our talking cupboard. Tell everyone I was the first to believe it could speak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Skip the welcome, then. Write down that I backed it before its first word.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says you talk too much.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write that it knows me from years of support. I'll let it have the last word.
